prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='NaiveMovingAverage', seasonality_champion='NaiveSeasonal', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: STL decomposition shows NaiveMovingAverage perfectly captures the upward trend (corr=1.0) while NaiveSeasonal best matches seasonal patterns (corr=0.429), but both have poor RMSE (>1200). ML models with wavelet/transform features dominate overall (ONLY_CWT_rf: 12.04 RMSE). The extreme disagreement (spread ratio 151.2) and split pattern champions suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to combine structural pattern capture with ML signal extraction.
